title: Hybrid Semantic Context-Enhanced Ensemble Learning for Wind Power Ramp-Event Forecasting and Uncertainty-Aware Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2608.29024v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Wind power ramp events which are sudden, large swings in turbine output over short windows are difficult to estimate, and standard models often miss them. Hybrid forecasting approach is built which augments semantic context to ramp-event forecast. Rather than applying an extensive language model directly to predict turbine operating data, we have implemented a pipeline where turbine operating data is converted to simplified text, which is then converted to dense embeddings to be used as inputs for ensemble models incorporated with other features. Testing runs are performed at multiple intervals within the SDWPF dataset, including 10-minute, 30-minute, and 60- minute horizons, with ramp events constituting the highest change in future power output. translated_title: 面向风电功率爬坡事件预测与不确定性感知评估的混合语义上下文增强集成学习方法
translated_abstract: 风电功率爬坡事件是指风电机组输出在短时间窗口内发生的大幅突变，这类事件难以估计，标准模型常常无法捕捉到它们。本文构建了一种混合预测方法，将语义上下文增强引入爬坡事件预测。我们没有直接应用大型语言模型来预测风机运行数据，而是实现了一条处理流水线：先将风机运行数据转换为简化文本，再将其转换为稠密嵌入向量，与其他特征一起作为集成模型的输入。我们在SDWPF数据集上以多个时间尺度进行了测试，包括10分钟、30分钟和60分钟预测时域，其中爬坡事件被定义为未来功率输出的最大变化。我们使用Diebold-Mariano检验和自助法置信区间，对照自回归、LSTM和GRU等基线模型以及多种集成配置检验了方法的稳健性，并改变了爬坡阈值……
tldr: 该论文提出一种混合语义上下文增强的集成学习方法，通过将风机运行数据转换为文本嵌入并与其他特征共同输入集成模型，在10/30/60分钟多个预测时域上提升了风电爬坡事件预测的准确性，并结合统计检验实现了不确定性感知的稳健评估。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid semantic context-enhanced ensemble learning approach that converts turbine operating data into dense text embeddings fed into ensemble models, improving wind power ramp-event forecasting across 10-, 30-, and 60-minute horizons with uncertainty-aware, statistically validated evaluation.
